description: Recorded on a real testnet node (2026-10-25, hardfork 1553): a bare unit running the previous release (hardfork 1552) bootstraps the current state, panics "unexpected state hardfork version" before writing visor_abci_state.json, systemd restarts it every ~30 s; recover.sh --apply installs the current release, the node catches up (lag 0.6 s).
